Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Schraube belegt?

In this glossary, Schraube belegt refers to: A condition where the propeller is entangled with ropes, nets, or debris, affecting maneuverability.

How is Schraube belegt used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "MV Vega, Schraube vermutlich belegt, Geschwindigkeit nicht haltbar, bitte Schlepperhilfe an Ankerplatz Bravo."

Why does Schraube belegt matter in maritime?

Schraube belegt matters because it supports clear communication in External Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Schraube belegt?

Schraube belegt is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Schraube belegt belong to?

In this glossary, Schraube belegt is grouped under External Communication. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.
